انبعثوا (form VII)
# اِنْبَعَثُوا (inbaʕaṯū) /in.ba.ʕa.θuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
# اِنْبَعِثُوا (inbaʕiṯū) /in.ba.ʕi.θuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
